certAgeThreshold.description: The number of days after a certificate is created to trigger an alert.

certExpirationThreshold.description: The number of days before a certificate expires to trigger an alert.

defaultConnectors.description: A list of connector IDs to be used as default connectors for new alerts.

defaultEmail.description: The default email configuration for new alerts.

heartbeatIndices.description: An index pattern string to be used within the Uptime app and alerts to query Heartbeat data.
